AWS Lambda now supports customer-managed runtimes!

We've had lots of new serverless releases lately and with this one platform teams in your org can now own and manage the runtime contents along with a patching schedule. App teams can keep deploying Lambda functions via .zip https://t.co/kICN373PVY

AWS says new AgentCore runtimes now start your agent from a snapshot, not from scratch.

So random values, IDs and timestamps your agent creates at startup can be the same in every session. What changed on 12 Nov, and what to check before your next deploy 🧵 https://t.co/JEXGfRt0Um

Moved a Lambda function to a shared log group and its logs stopped? Setting LogGroup with the CLI doesn't touch the execution role. If the role's logging statement names only /aws/lambda/myFunction, the new group stays empty.
